description: Find bullion products whose current best verified premium sits at least 3 percentage points below their own 30-day premium median, or whose delivered price dropped at least 3% in 7 days, from OunceScout's stored offer history. Each deal carries offerCheckedAt and verificationMethod provenance for its winning offer. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).

limit.description: Maximum deals to return (1 to 25, default 10).

name: current_deals
title: Current Deals
